sections.bearsOn: Continues the Ministry of Forests and Range and the forest service.
Appointment of deputy minister, chief forester, regional and district managers and timber sales managers.
Minister's general duties over forest and range resources.
States the ministry's purposes, including integrated planning of timber, grazing and other resource values; a purpose clause with no duty on a block.
Minister may acquire land and dispose of acquired interests in land; no bearing on a block.
Minister may make agreements and research grants.
Minister may publish prescribed information or documents online.
Repealed; the range of sections holds no text in force.
Regulation-making power for publication under s. 6.1.
